root_cause.text: The debugfs file "trace_mask" was created with an incorrect private data pointer (`fw_trace` instead of `pvr_dev`), causing `pvr_fw_trace_mask_set` to dereference a NULL pointer when accessing the `struct pvr_device` members.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the data argument from `fw_trace` to `pvr_dev` in `debugfs_create_file()` for "trace_mask". The crash backtrace shows the fault in `pvr_fw_trace_mask_set` at a NULL dereference (address 0), and the commit message states "Fix invalid data access by passing right data for debugfs entry."

commit a331631496a0af9a6f4e7e1860983afd8b1bb013
Author: Matt Coster <matt.coster@imgtec.com>
Date:   Tue Jan 13 10:16:39 2026 +0000

    drm/imagination: Simplify module parameters
    
    We had a whole load of bloaty infrastructure to deal with module parameters
    in a way that's wholly unnecessary. Strip it all back to basics to make
    adding new parameters less of a headache.
    
    Reviewed-by: Alessio Belle <alessio.belle@imgtec.com>
    Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260113-devic
bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces debugfs_create_file("trace_mask", 0600, dir, fw_trace, &pvr_fw_trace_mask_fops) at line 503 of the diff, passing fw_trace (a struct pvr_fw_trace pointer) as private data. However, pvr_fw_trace_mask_set (defined in the same diff at line 467) casts its data parameter to struct pvr_device *, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when accessing pvr_dev->fw_dev.fw_trace.group_mask. The correct private data should be pvr_dev, not fw_trace, and this commit does not include that fix.
